chunks.heading: Who I am
chunks.text: Who I am. I am Uma, a Senior AI Engineer based in Nottingham, UK. I have 11+ years in tech: 4+ years in Big Data engineering and 2+ years building agentic and GenAI systems in production.

chunks.heading: How I got here
chunks.text: How I got here. I started as a Big Data and Java engineer, building Spark and Hive pipelines for data transformations and storage at Standard Chartered Bank. I moved into AI to stay ahead of where technology is heading, and because I wanted to build applications end to end: from data and retrieval, through the model and agent logic, to the interface people actually use. Big Data gave me a strong foundation in reliable pipelines, and AI let me take that further into products that reason, respond and deliver value directly to users.

chunks.heading: What I care about
chunks.text: What I care about. Systems that are measurable. I would rather ship a simple retrieval pipeline with an evaluation gate than a complex agent nobody can debug. I think in tradeoffs: cost, latency, accuracy and production risk.

chunks.heading: What I am looking for
chunks.text: What I am looking for. Senior Agentic AI Engineer roles where I can design and own multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines and the evaluation around them. I am also open to customer-facing or stakeholder-facing roles, such as Forward Deployed or Applied AI Engineer, where I can work directly with users to understand their problems and turn them into working AI solutions.

chunks.heading: Senior AI Engineer, EdTech platforms (2+ years)
chunks.text: Senior AI Engineer, EdTech platforms (2+ years). Built production GenAI and agentic systems for EdTech products: a multi-agent support triage system and a RAG-based Learning Assistant involving Langchain, langgraph. Used  Agentic AI frameworks like Crew AI, - Designed multi-agent workflows with LangGraph and LangChain, using Pydantic structured outputs so every agent returns typed, checkable results. - Built RAG pipelines with hybrid retrieval (BM25 plus dense vectors, merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion) and cross-encoder reranking. - Added evaluation as a CI gate using RAGAS and DeepEval, so a drop in answer quality blocks a release. - Built FastAPI services with async concurrency for parallel LLM calls, retries and rate-limit handling. - Handled observability with LangSmith and Langfuse tracing. - Worked on deployment to Azure AKS with KEDA autoscaling. A separate DevOps engineer owned the cluster; I configured and deployed the services.

chunks.heading: Big Data Engineer, Standard Chartered Bank (4+ years)
chunks.text:
Big Data Engineer, Standard Chartered Bank (4+ years). Built data transformations pipelines and regulatory reporting pipelines over large-scale banking data.

- Spark, Scala and Hive for transformations, aggregations and reconciliation. - Sqoop for ingestion and Oozie for scheduling. - Focus on data accuracy, reconciliation and on-time submission for compliance and audit.

chunks.heading: Earlier experience
chunks.text: Earlier experience. Java and data engineering roles that built my foundation in backend systems.

chunks.heading: Agentic Support Triage System (EdTech)
chunks.text:
Agentic Support Triage System (EdTech). Automatically classifies and routes student support tickets: app bugs, loginfailures, payment issues, content errors and exam queries.

- Agents assign severity, gather context from logs, retrieve answers from a knowledge base, and escalate high-risk cases to a human. - Built with LangGraph and LangChain, Pydantic structured outputs, Pinecone for retrieval, FastAPI and Redis. - Hardest problems: non-deterministic escalation, context overflow in long tickets, and observability gaps. Fixed with explicit state, typed outputs and tracing.

chunks.heading: EdTech Learning Assistant (RAG)
chunks.text:
EdTech Learning Assistant (RAG). A study assistant that answers learner questions from course material.

-  OCR pipeline to turn scanned material into searchable text. - Hybrid retrieval with BM25 and dense embeddings, merged with RRF, then cross-encoder reranking. - RAGAS evaluation gates in CI. - An ML engineer on the team owned the classification models; I integrated their outputs into the pipeline.

chunks.heading: This portfolio chatbot
chunks.text:
This portfolio chatbot. A live chat that answers questions about my experience, grounded in these notes.

- Retrieval over my own markdown files, answers generated with the Groq API. - Guard layer to keep answers on topic and grounded. - Evaluation set measuring retrieval hit rate and answer correctness separately. - Deployed on Vercel with serverless functions.

chunks.heading: Smaller builds
chunks.text: Smaller builds. - File Organiser Agent: a Python agent for practising tool use. - Meal planning web app in Python. - Story generation for special needs kids

chunks.heading: Languages
chunks.text: Languages. Python is my main language and worked with: FastAPI, asyncio, dataclasses, Pydantic and LLM SDKs. Scala and Java from my Big Data years. SQL well enough to write complex Hive and Spark SQL for reconciliation work. JavaScript for front ends and serverless functions.

chunks.heading: Agentic AI
chunks.text: Agentic AI. Multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph and LangChain. I have also used CrewAI and, in hindsight, prefer LangGraph when a workflow needs explicit state,deterministic routing and human-in-the-loop escalation. Tool calling, context management and structured outputs.

chunks.heading: Data engineering
chunks.text: Data engineering. Spark, Hive, Sqoop, Oozie. Batch pipelines, data validation and reconciliation for regulated environments.
